d: Jo bhi nirdosh ke lie piradayi va anarthakari ho use nasht karna hi chahie , unka samul nash karna aavashyak hai. vishnugupt jab gyanasbha men pahunchte hain aur vahan dekhte hain ki samrat dhannand ka ahankar bahut barh gaya hai tab dekhiye kya hota hai sabha men. kya ye sab prashn aaj ke vaishvik vatavran men satik nahin baithte ? kament boks men likh kar bataiye aapko vishnugupt (chanaky) ka kaunsa sanvad sabse achchha laga.
